title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chozhan gets angry over Nadesan's plan to bring Sembaruthi home. Meanwhile, Cheran reveals Pallavan's birth secret to Chandayatha when she presses him for the truth.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi reveals their secret movie plan, prompting a furious Ragavan to cancel the outing. Malar and Mathi blame Lakshmi's carelessness as they call Revathi to go back home.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Savithri questions Aishwarya about Chithra's role. Refusing the lawyer's request, Rajangam avoids meeting Chithra in jail, while Tamizhselvi and Vasanthi worry for Vellathai.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Pooja worries as Aadhavan forces her to claim she loves no one. Later, Madhu rejects Shyam's proposal, refuses to clear her dad's loan, and faces his threat to marry him.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani defends Mayuri and insists that Vennila provide proof of her theft allegation. Then, Maya enjoys a grand birthday celebration filled with everyone's warm wishes.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Lakshmi worries about Abhi adjusting to their modest lifestyle due to her rich background. Meanwhile, Indhira suggests Murugan start a catering business alongside the mess.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi and Pandian receive a grand welcome as the family performs traditional rituals. Later, the family secretly plans to arrange a wedding night for the newlyweds.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
episodeTitle: Vijaya Takes Charge of Meena's Care
description: Vijaya rejects Sinthamani's money offer for Meena's pregnancy care and promises to look after her. Later, the family tries to persuade Shruthi to continue her pregnancy.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
episodeTitle: Vetri Clears the Air with Shanmugam
description: Sandhya is furious as a video of Vetri rejecting her goes viral, shocking Shanmugam, Sarala, and Abinaya. Vetri clarifies the incident and reminisces about his parents with Sudar.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi fails to wake Azhagar, making Mayandi and Meenatchi lash out over farm duty. After a proposal arrives for Senthamizh, Meenatchi leaves for the temple.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma is enraged as Ilamathi declares her house President Paraman's residence. Ilamathi further honours Paraman's leadership by gifting him a Royal Enfield.
